{{Top|leg}}
'''Government Palace''' was a newly constructed building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Derilysa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. It was the residence of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]], [[Governor/Legends|Martial Governor]] of Derilyn, and had been built on the ruins of the planet's previous government buildings.
